comparison: Regresses vs unified-v11 (16/16) and law4-muon-m (12/15 graded PASS): proves negative/optimistic momentum harms stochastic minibatch GAN settling once Law 2 Born-Infeld critic regularization already controls rotational instability.
conclusion: Optimistic/Extragradient polar (g_eff = g_t + 0.5*(g_t - g_{t-1}), 1 state/param + 5-step Quintic NS) achieves 8/14 graded PASS (6 numerical FAIL, 1 TIMEOUT on five_word_joint_smoke under GPU contention, 1 prereq-gated grid100_mlp16) on r4-occam-ablation-v1, regressing vs unified-v11. While strong on balanced/imbalanced ring16 (hq=0.9927), img_bars4 (4/4 hq=1.0), vector_unequal_mass/width, and both >500x Nash tasks (hq=0.9126/0.9717), the 2.5x stochastic minibatch gradient variance amplification of 1.5*g_t - 0.5*g_{t-1} causes terminal suffix/settling failures on grid100 (final prec=0.9928, ctr=0.1225 yet missed live suffix), gaussian1d_stability, zero_tanh_rail_escape, t3_iso_scale_mass_8x (eig=0.3929), t3_iso_horizon_saddle_shift (hq=0.9141), and model_ddgan_gaussian_chain (t1_q0_mean=0.375, eig_max=1.45).
